generations.name: First generation (G65)
generations.notes: First electric X5, on the updated CLAR platform with Gen6 eDrive, 800 V. iX5 60 xDrive: about 141 kWh net (some reports 144 kWh), up to 460 kW DC peak, 10-80 % in about 22-23 min; US launch Q1 2027. Sources disagree on the pack figure. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.press.bmwgroup.com/usa/article/detail/T0458814EN_US/the-new-bmw-x5-and-ix5 ; https://insideevs.com/news/800125/bmw-ix5-neue-klasse-ev-electric-suv/ ; https://www.bmwblog.com/2026/06/30/2027-bmw-ix5-specs-range-charging-power-weight-towing/
